title: Add goal tool contract tests
objective: Define model-callable goal tools equivalent to current Codex runtime APIs.
context: Current Codex runtime exposes get_goal, create_goal, and update_goal tools in this session.
This Go project should expose equivalent model tools only after strict schema and metadata are tested.

source_evidence.note: get_goal, create_goal, and update_goal exist with explicit completion and blocked semantics.
Task tools show existing patterns for stateful model-facing tools.

include: Test CreateGoal validates objective and optional token budget.
Test UpdateGoal only marks complete or blocked from model side.
Test strict schema rejects unknown fields.
Test typed data is separate from model-visible text.

implementation_steps: Assert tool metadata for read-only and mutating tools.
Assert unknown field rejection if the shared contract layer supports it.
deliverables: Failing tests for goal model tools.
acceptance_criteria: Tests define GetGoal, CreateGoal, and UpdateGoal behavior.
UpdateGoal cannot edit arbitrary state beyond complete or blocked.
No real session repository is required.
risks: Tool APIs can accidentally duplicate slash command power too broadly.
dispatch_prompt: Add failing tests for GetGoal, CreateGoal, and UpdateGoal tools using a fake GoalRuntime. Cover strict schemas, metadata, typed output, complete, and blocked semantics.
notes_for_assignee: Keep model tools narrower than slash command controls; pause/resume/edit can remain user command only unless explicitly needed.
